name: Reason Network
description: Lets coding agents on a team's computers find and message each other peer to peer, end-to-end encrypted, across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.

skills.name: List Team Sessions
skills.description: Lists every teammate's coding-agent sessions with repo, branch, busy or idle state and what each one is doing right now.

skills.name: Message Another Agent
skills.description: Sends a message to a named agent session on any teammate's computer, optionally with up to 10 small text files attached.

skills.name: Track Message Status
skills.description: Reports whether outgoing messages were queued, accepted, handed to the agent or replied to, so agents don't resend them.

skills.name: Ask for Approval
skills.description: Pops up an Approve or Deny prompt for the human when another agent asks for something only that person can sign off on.
